steps.title: Request Authorization
steps.description: Authorize a user by redirecting them to the Pipedrive OAuth authorization page and request their permissions to act on their behalf. This step is necessary to implement only when you allow app installation outside of the Marketplace.

evidence.qualification: Directly supports requesting authorization by redirecting the user and handling the callback URL.

Requesting authorization

<hr />

<Callout icon="🚧" theme="warn">
  This step is necessary to implement only when you allow app installation **outside** of the Marketplace.
</Callout>

First, your app must start the authorization process. For that, you must redirect the customer’s web browser to make a request to the OAuth server’s `/authorize` endpoint:
quotations.contextAfter:

steps.title: Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens
steps.description: To exchange the authorization_code for the tokens, execute an HTTP POST request to the OAuth server, authenticated via HTTP Basic Auth with client_id and client_secret, using application/x-www-form-urlencoded content type and required body parameters grant_type, code, and redirect_uri.
steps.expectedOutcome: Receive a response with the JSON data containing access and refresh tokens.

evidence.qualification: Directly documents the POST endpoint, authentication mechanism, and body parameters for exchanging the authorization code.

quotations.quote:
| Body parameter | Description                                                                                                                 |
| :------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `grant_type`   | Since you are trying to exchange an authorization code for a pair of tokens, you must use the value `"authorization_code"`. |
| `code`         | The authorization code that you received after the user confirmed app installation.                                         |
| `redirect_uri` | The callback URL you provided when you registered your app.                                                                 |

quotations.quote: To execute the request, your request **has** to be authenticated via HTTP Basic Auth with the values of the `client_id` and the `client_secret` (you can find the values like [this](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/client-id-and-client-secret#how-to-get-your-client_id-and-client_secret)).
quotations.contextBefore:
<Callout icon="🚧" theme="warn">
  Note that the `authorization_code` expires in **5 minutes**.
</Callout>

To exchange the `authorization_code` for the tokens, you must execute this HTTP request to the OAuth server:

```text URL
POST https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token
```

The content-type for the request must be `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
